dx_dlbcl_non_gcb.quote: Immunophenotype is non-germinal-center B-cell-like (non-GCB/ABC-like) by the Hans algorithm

dx_hans_not_abc.note: Uses "ABC-like" loosely; never states Hans is only a surrogate for GEP-defined ABC.

stage_iii.quote: Ann Arbor stage IIIB with splenic involvement (IIIS), bulky.

stage_spleen_nodal.quote: because the spleen is a lymphatic organ, this remains stage III rather than IV

stage_bulky_b_symptoms.quote: Bulky disease is present (retroperitoneal mass 11.0 cm, greater than 10 cm). B symptoms are present

mol_de_not_dh.quote: It is a double-expressor lymphoma by immunohistochemistry (BCL2 about 80%, MYC about 50%, Ki-67 about 85%), but FISH is negative

prog_cns_ipi_intermediate.quote: CNS-IPI 2 (age over 60 and stage III), which is intermediate risk
prog_cns_ipi_intermediate.note: Risk category correct but score miscounted as 2 (omits LDH).

tx_curative_pola_or_rchop.quote: I recommend polatuzumab vedotin plus R-CHP (pola-R-CHP) every 21 days for 6 cycles

tx_pola_preferred.quote: exploratory analyses suggest greater benefit in ABC/non-GCB disease

tx_isrt_residual_bulk.quote: if Deauville 4-5 at the bulky site, biopsy and consider involved-site radiation

mn_dose_reduced_initial.quote: There is no frailty and no need for reduced-dose therapy.

hbv_prophylaxis.quote: monitor HBV DNA every 2-3 months during rituximab and for 6-12 months afterward, and start entecavir or tenofovir if DNA becomes detectable

hbv_dna_lft_monitoring.quote: monitor HBV DNA every 2-3 months during rituximab and for 6-12 months afterward

mn_no_hbv_action.quote: monitor HBV DNA every 2-3 months during rituximab and for 6-12 months afterward, and start entecavir or tenofovir if DNA becomes detectable
mn_no_hbv_action.note: Chooses pre-emptive monitoring instead of prophylaxis; HBV-directed action exists so not committed.

cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.quote: I will not give intrathecal chemotherapy or high-dose methotrexate prophylaxis, and I will not perform a routine baseline lumbar puncture

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: End-of-treatment PET-CT will be obtained 6-8 weeks after cycle 6 and interpreted by Lugano 2014/Deauville criteria.

resp_ds45_biopsy.quote: If the 11-cm retroperitoneal site is Deauville 4-5, I will biopsy it to distinguish residual lymphoma from inflammation

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: Start allopurinol 300 mg daily 1-2 days before cycle 1 and continue for at least 7 days, with IV hydration

sup_gcsf.quote: pegfilgrastim 6 mg SC on day 2 of each cycle

work_echo_reviewed.quote: He is fit for full-dose curative anthracycline-based therapy: age 62, ECOG 1, fully independent, working part-time, LVEF 58%

fit_full_dose.quote: He is fit for full-dose curative anthracycline-based therapy

miss_hbv_dna.quote: Baseline quantitative HBV DNA is not in the record despite HBsAg-negative/anti-HBc-positive status
